name: io.github.suprsend/cli
title: SuprSend
description: Manage SuprSend entities — workflows, templates, users, objects, tenants — from your AI assistant.

environmentVariables.name: SUPRSEND_SERVICE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: SuprSend service token. Create one in the SuprSend dashboard under Developers → API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: SUPRSEND_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base API URL. Only set for BYOC / self-hosted SuprSend instances.

environmentVariables.name: SUPRSEND_MGMNT_URL
environmentVariables.description: Management API URL. Only set for BYOC / self-hosted SuprSend instances.
